sourceStories: F:/提示词/剧情/宿命回响_第*章*.md

jobs.sceneCore: a narrow residential alley branching from the rain-soaked Miansha town square, patched awnings, silent piano shop windows, old brick apartments and a small sheltered stairway
jobs.camera: wide human-eye view with open center and right staging space
mustInclude: one distant silent upright piano silhouette

jobs.sceneCore: the modest dining room of an old railway inn at Fog-Cocoon Station, worn wooden tables, enamel cups, a small stove and windows clouded by morning mist
jobs.camera: wide interior from doorway height, clean foreground table edge and left/right sprite zones
mustInclude: old railway timetable shapes without legible text

jobs.sceneCore: a compact expedition camp below the frozen observatory, low windbreak tents, blue-white snowfield, equipment crates and a protected smokeless fire bowl
jobs.camera: wide intimate camp composition with clear seated-character space around the fire

jobs.sceneCore: a restricted archive reading room inside White Score Academy, white marble ribs, tall dark shelves, brass catalog drawers, a central evidence table and stained-glass clerestory
jobs.camera: symmetrical wide interior with an uncluttered center table and side sprite zones

jobs.sceneCore: the black-lacquer Nightless Touring opera train racing beside a mountain maintenance road while a reinforced service vehicle aligns with an open boarding hatch
jobs.camera: wide side perspective, train dominating upper frame, safe negative space near lower center

jobs.sceneCore: a narrow ritual carriage before the organ core, black lacquer walls, crimson kneeling rails, fractured choir lecterns and a restrained thorn-shaped altar
jobs.camera: wide centered aisle with open duel space and readable exits at both ends
avoid: church nave larger than a train

jobs.sceneCore: the Nightless Touring train finally stopped in an empty field at first light, open carriage doors, quiet tracks and faint steam after the false applause has ended
jobs.camera: wide exterior establishing shot with calm foreground and space for survivors
mustInclude: black lacquer train retaining crimson details

jobs.sceneCore: the working backstage of the Floating Light Circus, repaired masks, ropes, painted props, costume trunks and a practical scheduling desk behind the main tent
jobs.camera: wide interior with a clear center floor and two layered side entrances
mustInclude: cozy but slightly restrictive ceiling ropes

jobs.sceneCore: the reinforced upper catwalk and roof ridge inside the circus tent, high above the darkened ring with a canvas gap revealing a star-filled night
jobs.camera: wide elevated but stable composition, broad beam suitable for two seated sprites

jobs.sceneCore: the circus camp entrance at cool early morning, folded banners, warming food cart, travel wagons and the main orange-red tent receding behind the road
jobs.camera: wide farewell composition with open road leading out of frame and clear foreground staging

jobs.sceneCore: an open-sided rural repair shed beside the terrace waterwheel, wooden gears, hand tools, irrigation channels and golden fields visible beyond
jobs.camera: wide workshop view with uncluttered floor and bright outdoor depth

jobs.sceneCore: an old practice room inside White Score Academy at night, the same white marble and gold trim as chapter 3, one closed grand piano, petition drafts and rain-dark windows
jobs.camera: wide intimate interior with open area beside the piano for speakers

jobs.sceneCore: deep archive stacks beneath White Score Academy, white stone structural ribs, dark shelving, rolling brass ladders and original registration ledgers opened on a reading table
jobs.camera: wide aisle view with center evidence table and clean left foreground

jobs.sceneCore: a restrained senior adjudicator's private study inside the academy, white stone walls, crimson document ribbon, locked case files and one narrow stained-glass window
jobs.camera: wide three-quarter interior with desk pushed back and clear conversational foreground

jobs.sceneCore: the academy workers' dining hall, marble columns simplified by long wooden tables, steam from plain soup, brass serving counter and evening rain outside
jobs.camera: wide welcoming room with clear front table and side serving area
mustInclude: institutional architecture softened by daily life

jobs.sceneCore: the collapsed waiting hall of the fallen Dark Touring station, broken clock, empty benches, rain entering through the roof and one untouched empty performance seat
jobs.camera: wide low human-eye view with central empty seat and clear side staging

jobs.sceneCore: a sheltered former ticket office repurposed as a temporary repair nook, wooden desk, disassembled pocket-watch tools, sealed letters and rain on the glass
jobs.camera: wide close interior with desk on one side and open conversational space on the other

jobs.sceneCore: the ruined station platform after rain at first dawn, damp rails, extinguished campfire, an empty chair now turned toward the living camp instead of the tracks
jobs.camera: wide calm ending frame with open foreground and pale horizon

jobs.sceneCore: the entrance courtyard of an abandoned faction outpost when wind and insects have gone unnaturally silent, broken gate, wet stone, precise silver footprints and a dark moonlit approach
jobs.camera: wide confrontation space with deep centered entrance and open foreground

jobs.sceneCore: the same abandoned outpost courtyard the morning after the farewell, scattered burned list ashes, one remaining half ornament and a clear route leading onward
jobs.camera: wide quiet aftermath with low horizon and uncluttered center

jobs.sceneCore: a practical northbound roadside camp beside a repaired utility vehicle, map cases, drying winter gear and a sheltered low fire under sparse trees
jobs.camera: wide camp composition with three clean sprite positions around the low fire

jobs.sceneCore: the vine-covered old residence doorstep at winter dusk, worn stone threshold, quiet yard, stacked travel cases and a northward road visible beyond the gate
jobs.camera: wide intimate exterior with the threshold as a seated-character zone

jobs.sceneCore: the largest frontier trading post in Frostpass Town, sturdy timber-and-stone interior, fur rolls, dry food bins, medicine shelves, weighing scale and a practical supply counter
jobs.camera: wide interior with open counter front and two clean side staging zones

jobs.sceneCore: a small frontier guide station, layered hand-drawn route maps, snowshoes, rope, old expedition mugs and a scarred wooden table beside a narrow stove
jobs.camera: wide conversational room with clear map table and open standing space

jobs.sceneCore: a sheltered lane joining the town smithy and herb shop, one side glowing forge and workbench, the other side hanging dried cold-weather herbs and a compact heating device under repair
jobs.camera: wide balanced two-shop composition with clear central work area

jobs.sceneCore: a small open square between low frontier homes after fresh snow, packed footpaths, simple wooden sled, harmless snow forts and warm windows around the edges
jobs.camera: wide playful clearing with large empty center for sprite and minigame overlays

jobs.sceneCore: the timber-and-stone northern gate of Frostpass Town where the marked road ends and the uncharted snowfield begins, supply sled tracks leading into white distance
jobs.camera: wide farewell frame from inside the gate with open foreground and vast north beyond
mustInclude: clear boundary between home and unknown
